description: MegaPrime is the wide-field prime focus upper end assembly and instrument system at CFHT supporting MegaCam, containing broadband filters as well as narrowband and intermediate filters.
short_description: CFHT MegaPrime broad-, narrow- and medium-band filters (full, filter)
facility_description: The Canada-France-Hawaii Telescope (CFHT) is a 3.6-meter optical and infrared telescope operated by NRC (Canada), CNRS/INSU (France), and the University of Hawaii, located on Maunakea in Hawaii.
notes: MegaPrime designates the prime focus upper end environment accommodating MegaCam, its wide-field corrector optics, and filter juke-box. Filter profiles in this inventory include the Sloan-like broadband sets (including _fil variants) and specialized narrowband filters (e.g. CaHK, Halpha, OIII, TiO, NB920).

licence.scope: No statement on the CFHT filter pages; MegaCam curves via CADC MegaPipe (Canada.ca terms not verified).

acknowledgements.text: Based on observations obtained at the Canada-France-Hawaiʻi Telescope (CFHT) which is operated by the National Research Council of Canada, the Institut National des Sciences de l'Univers of the Centre National de la Recherche Scientifique of France, and the University of Hawaiʻi. CFHT is located on Maunakea on Hawaiʻi Island, a mountain of considerable cultural, natural, and ecological significance. Maunakea is a sacred site to Native Hawaiians, also known as Kānaka ʻŌiwi. Quality observations are made possible by relentless effort of the entire staff at Canada-France-Hawaiʻi Telescope. Based on observations obtained with MegaPrime/MegaCam, a joint project of CFHT and CEA/DAPNIA.
This research used the facilities of the Canadian Astronomy Data Centre operated by the National Research Council of Canada with the support of the Canadian Space Agency.

CaHK.DetectorType_note: The only archived capture of SVO's CFHT/Megaprime.CaHK (2022-09-29, 'Megaprime CaHK, cfh9303', components 'Filter', energy) predates SVO's split: its array is NJM's CaHK_fil exactly (ratio 1.000). SVO's current records are split: Megaprime.X is the full system curve and Megaprime.X_fil the filter-only curve, both DetectorType 1 (photon), e.g. Megaprime.u 2026-01-12 and z 2025-12-08 ('(full)'), CaHK_fil 2025-11-18 and gri_fil 2026-01-20 ('(filter only)'). NJM's CaHK is the full curve (filter+optics+qe+instrument, photon), so the flag is a version difference, not a detector-type conflict. Refresh once a current capture of this ID is archived.

NB920_fil.Comments: SVO match re-pointed (2026-10-26) to CFHT/Megaprime.NB920_fil, SVO's filter-only record for this filter; it was matched by band name and pivot to a 2021-22 capture of CFHT/Megaprime.NB920 taken before SVO split X (full) from X_fil (filter only). CFHT/Megaprime.NB920_fil is in SVO's ID list but has no archived capture yet, so this band shows no SVO record until one is harvested.
